resources.string: Review or cancel the latest installation session

This APK can replace an app with the same ID and signing identity. Android decides compatibility; updating can change behavior or data. Factory permissions control installation separately from signing: Allow always proceeds, Ask reviews this exact APK once, and Deny blocks it. Android may require its own installer confirmation. Jarvys does not grant a missing source permission or claim success from opening a screen.
Android reported success for this exact session. App behavior and preservation of data have not been tested.
Installation success is not established by this state. Cancellation after commit does not prove rollback. After interruption, review or cancel; never replay commit.
The operation could not complete. Review the state, per-source permission and artifact validity. Cancel if needed; nothing is retried automatically.
Cancel the outstanding session or wait for its outcome before closing. An unknown result is never treated as success.
An automated action was already in flight. Leave this screen and reopen it manually when the action ends; approval is disabled.

Android does not currently allow installations from Jarvys. Enable the source permission in Android settings if you want to install, then make a new request. No installer session was created and unrelated automation remains available.
The installation permission could not be checked. No installer session was created. Close this review and make a fresh request after resolving the device issue yourself.
Integrated installation is unavailable in this distribution or Android version. Keep the signed project artifact.
Cancel owned sessions and recover record

The installation record is unreadable. Recovery cancels remaining installer sessions owned by Jarvys (up to 16) and may discard staged APK data. It cannot undo completed installs or recover lost outcomes. It does not uninstall apps or change signing identities. Unknown historical records do not block unrelated automation.
The record was recovered after confirming no Jarvys-owned installer sessions remain. Lost outcomes are still unknown; no success or rollback is claimed.
